verdicts.explanation: The homepage's canonical tag points to an unrelated spotlight article on a different host (tlecms.mit.edu), not to the homepage itself, and the same off-domain pattern hits the site's most important pages (about, contact, admissions-aid), so this is not confined to duplicate or archived pages.
The homepage carries no JSON-LD at all, so it declares no Organization or sameAs links that would anchor the MIT brand entity for a disambiguating assistant.
The contact page's footer social links are bare anchors wrapping only an inline SVG icon, with no aria-label, title or accessible text, matching the unnamed-control defect the check reports.

fixes.quote: MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology Skip to content
site_specific: Change the canonical link tag on https://www.mit.edu/ to point at https://www.mit.edu/ itself, not the tlecms.mit.edu authoring host.
Apply the same fix to /about, /contact, /accessibility, /admissions-aid and the other pages currently canonicalizing to tlecms.mit.edu.
Confirm the CMS publish step rewrites the authoring-domain canonical to the public www.mit.edu URL before a page goes live.
Add aria-label values ("Twitter", "Facebook", "Instagram", etc.) to the anchors under the site-footer__social-list that currently wrap only an SVG icon.
Reuse the same fix across every page that includes this shared footer.
